products.name: Architectural Fiddle Leaf Fig
products.description: The quintessential interior architectural plant. Prized by interior designers for its oversized, violin-shaped, deep emerald leathery leaves. Acclimatized in our Tathawade nursery under controlled shade cloth for robust domestic resilience.

careGuide.light: Bright, filtered indirect sunlight. Avoid harsh direct afternoon Pune sun.
careGuide.water: Water thoroughly only when top 2 inches of soil feel completely dry. Good drainage is vital.
careGuide.height: 4.5 to 5.5 ft mature nursery height; reaches 8+ ft indoors with proper care.
careGuide.temperature: Thrives at 18°C - 32°C. Keep protected from cold AC air currents.
careGuide.soil: Aerated cocopeat, vermicompost, and perlite blend with pH 6.0 - 6.8.

products.deliveryNote: White-glove delivery across Pune metropolitan limits within 48 hours. Delivered directly in potting medium by our nursery logistics crew.

products.name: Monstera Deliciosa (Specimen Cut-Leaf)
products.description: Classic tropical biophilic foliage featuring dramatic deep fenestrations (natural leaf splits). Excellent air purifying qualities, ideal for high-ceiling living rooms, covered verandahs, and executive suites.

careGuide.light: Moderate to bright indirect natural light. Performs well in east-facing windows.
careGuide.water: Weekly deep watering in summers, once every 10–12 days during winter.
careGuide.height: 2.5 to 3.5 ft including starter moss pole support.

variants.label: Standard 10-inch Pot with Coco Moss Pole

products.deliveryNote: Direct nursery truck delivery with care manual and acclimation spray.

products.name: Australian Foxtail Palm (Avenue Grade)
products.description: Architectural single-trunk feather palm with lush bushy fronds resembling a fox's tail. Self-cleaning smooth crownshaft. The gold standard for modern luxury villa driveways and club entrances.

careGuide.light: Full direct sun. Highly heat and drought tolerant once rooted.
careGuide.water: Deep watering twice weekly during establishment; drought hardy thereafter.
careGuide.height: 7 to 8 ft rooted nursery root-ball; matures up to 25 ft in Western Maharashtra.

products.deliveryNote: Delivered via flatbed truck. Crane unloading coordination available for bulk orders.

products.name: Singapore Dwarf White Frangipani
products.description: Evergreen rounded foliage with exquisite, fragrant waxy white flowers with golden centers. Unlike common Plumeria rubra, obtusa retains glossy foliage year-round in Pune climates without winter defoliation.

careGuide.light: 6+ hours of direct sunlight for maximum profuse flowering.
careGuide.water: Moderate. Allow soil to dry moderately between watering cycles.

variants.label: 6 Ft Specimen in Handcrafted Grey Terrazzo Pot

products.deliveryNote: Carefully wrapped in transit netting to protect bud clusters.

products.name: Golden Goddess Clumping Bamboo (Hedge Grade)
products.description: Non-invasive clumping bamboo (will never crack pavements or invade neighbor plots). Tight golden culms with dense feathery emerald leaves. The ideal acoustic and visual privacy buffer for boundary walls.

careGuide.light: Full sun to dappled afternoon shade.
careGuide.water: Regular watering for rapid vertical shoot growth.
careGuide.height: 6 to 7 ft dense culm cluster; trims cleanly to any desired height.

variants.label: 6 Ft Clump (5-7 culms) in 12-inch Grow Bag
8 Ft Dense Cluster (10+ culms) in 18-inch Container

products.deliveryNote: Shipped upright in custom nursery cages.

products.name: Madagascar Almond (Architectural Tiered Tree)
products.description: Striking layered horizontal pagodal branching structure. Tiny delicate deciduous leaves create dappled, elegant shade without aggressive root upheavals. The premier choice for contemporary minimalist architecture.

careGuide.water: Deep root soaking during first 12 months after transplant.
careGuide.height: 9 to 10 ft straight leader trunk, caliper 2.5 inches.

products.deliveryNote: Flatbed transportation required. Nursery horticulturist accompanies delivery for site placement advice.

products.name: Pune Basalt Handcrafted GFRC Planter
products.description: Glass Fiber Reinforced Concrete (GFRC) pot custom textured to evoke natural Deccan basalt rock. 70% lighter than solid stone, frost and UV resistant, with integrated concealed drainage overflow tube.

careGuide.light: All weather resistant. Does not crack under direct harsh sun.

products.name: Estate Bio-Conditioned Potting Substrate (25kg)
products.description: Proprietary nursery blend formulated specifically for Maharashtra soil conditions: washed cocopeat fibers, vermicompost enriched with neem cake, horticultural volcanic perlite, and beneficial mycorrhizae for rapid root growth.

careGuide.light: Ready to use immediately for container plants or garden beds.
careGuide.water: High moisture retention while preventing root rot.
